data.name: Yuki Onna: Snowball Fight!
data.detailed_description:
“Yuki Onna: Snowball Fight!” is a 3D multiplayer party game supporting 2–16 players online. In this joyful ice-and-snow world you’ll use agile movement and flight to dodge attacks, blast your friends with snowballs, and collect scattered “Frost Cores” across the map to continuously strengthen your snowballs and character stats — all to win this chaotic, laugh-out-loud snowball brawl.

Online & Local Multiplayer

Whether it’s a small gathering of friends or a full 16-player free-for-all, this game multiplies the fun. Lock onto your target amid swirling snow, hurl snowballs at your opponents, and enjoy the pure, friendship-destroying joy of chaotic group matches!

3D Mobility & Aerial Evasion

Standing still and spamming is over! On these expansive 3D battlefields you can use high-freedom movement and a unique flight mechanic to maneuver in three dimensions. Twist and dodge in midair to narrowly escape deadly snowballs coming from every direction — nimble positioning and precise controls are the key to surviving until the end.

Compete for “Frost Cores” — Endless Upgrades

Want your snowballs to hit harder? Keep an eye out for the “Frost Cores” that spawn randomly around the map! Collecting them grants powerful buffs: upgrade your snowball’s attack types and power, and boost your character’s movement and flight abilities. The scramble for cores creates dynamic, high-stakes battles that make every match unpredictable and thrilling.

Stunning 3D Frozen Arenas

The game features immersive 3D ice-and-snow environments. Use complex terrain as cover to outplay opponents, or fly to high ground to rain down pressure. In these detailed, three-dimensional arenas, discover the tactics that fit your playstyle.
